Around this central figure, multiple perfectly crafted 3D glossy chibi mini-versions of the same subject are arranged playfully: one version mid-leap with joyful arms raised, one waving enthusiastically with a wide smile, one seated cross-legged in a relaxed cute pose, one holding a bubble tea cup with two hands. Aesthetic casual handwritten typography reads "shine", "bright day", "happy", "smile" in light brushpen doodle font. Clean white sticker-outline borders surround chibi figures. Soft pastel color grading — lavender, blush pink, mint, cream. 8K high-detail digital rendering, 4:5 aspect ratio.
